focus.cue: bracket set: 8 strokes, sizes 10px 2px, 2px 10px on "BEGIN NEW OPERATION"

lock.cue: locked tab prints "BRIEF LOCKED NO CONTRACT SELECTED" + lock glyph; selected tab "WORLD NETWORK" framed 2px solid (rgb(126, 240, 212))

selection.cue: 2 cards: closed double ring (outline double 3px rgb(126, 240, 212)) + bracketed slot "["1]

objective.cue: "REACH THE CHECKPOINT GATE" prints token "ACTIVE" + triangle mark (#9be8ff); row colour rgb(155, 232, 255)

injury-kia.cue: injured card: pips at 20% + health bar framed 2px dashed + "22/110" + "+ INJURED"; KIA card: skull glyph + "FLATLINED" + struck-through name

alert.cue: prints "||| ALERT: 2 |||" bold (700) in a 2px frame, blinking bars, edge glow on

collateral-credits.cue: chip "COLLATERAL 2" in rgb(184, 216, 207) (ink #b8d8cf); credits "128,450 CR" in rgb(255, 208, 117)

high-contrast.cue: high contrast on: Alert frame 2px, injured bar dashed, selection double

result-won.cue: banner prints "CONTRACT FULFILLED EXTRACTION CONFIRMED"; title contrast 14.5:1

result-lost.cue: banner prints "SQUAD ELIMINATED CONTRACT TERMINATED"; title contrast 17.7:1

menu.font: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, "Cascadia Mono", "Roboto Mono", monospace

mission-hud.font: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, "Cascadia Mono", "Roboto Mono", monospace
